title: RampCast staffing plan input
description: Historical timesheet data for a set of comparable past projects, aggregated to the WBS project/phase/task level. Each project carries its own relative week axis: week 0 is the first week that project had any hours charged to it. Input to the staffing plan generation LLM call.

projects.description: One entry per distinct wbs1 code across all uploaded exports. A single export may contain several projects, and several exports may contribute rows to the same project.

wbsCode.description: Top-level project WBS code, e.g. R26.0001.00

weekZeroStart.description: Calendar Monday of this project's week 0. For human traceability and to indicate roughly when the project ran. Do NOT use it to align this project against another — all cross-project comparison uses the relative week indices.

durationWeeks.description: First charged week through last, inclusive (lastChargedWeek + 1). Dormant weeks in between are still counted, so the ramp keeps its real gaps.

firstChargedWeek.description: Always 0 — each project defines its own week axis from its own first charged week.

lastChargedWeek.description: 0-based index of the last week this project had any hours charged.

weeklyHours.description: Hours charged directly at the project level, with no WBS phase assigned — e.g. pursuit/business-development hours logged before the project had a phase breakdown set up. Unlike phase vs. task (a strict either/or: once a phase has tasks, all of its hours live under them), unphased project-level hours can coexist alongside phases — a project commonly has some pre-award hours here and its post-award work broken into phases below.
Populated only when tasks is empty — leaf-level hours live wherever the WBS bottoms out.

wbsCode.description: Task-level WBS code, e.g. CA or SO

chargedWeek.description: 0-based index on the parent project's week axis. OBSERVED charge activity — when hours actually landed — not a planned schedule date.

weekIndex.description: 0-based week offset from the parent project's week 0 (the Monday of the first week that project had any hours charged). Entries are SPARSE: a week/role combination that is absent means zero hours for that week, not missing or unknown data.
